title: worldview.telemetry.v1
description: Canonical normalized event envelope every ingestion worker emits to Kafka. See worldview/docs/01-architecture-and-schema.md §3.

domain.description: Which data layer this event belongs to.

source.description: Provenance of the observation (e.g. 'opensky', 'aisstream', 'celestrak'), for dedup and trust scoring.

entity_id.description: Stable per-track id: icao24 | mmsi | norad_id | h3_index | event_id. Kafka partition key.

ts.description: Event time, UNIX seconds (float, ms precision). The fourth dimension.

ingested_at.description: When the worker observed the message, UNIX seconds. For latency monitoring.

alt_m.description: Altitude in meters; null for sea-level entities.

geom_wkt.description: Optional WKT for polygon-bearing events (footprints, NOTAMs, zones).
